timing: locked after F-only base fits and before E5-C outcome aggregation
control_folds: Matched global/task/subtask controls preserve switch counts within each outer fold's frozen procedure. Bootstrap re-computes those counts within every original-question resample.
u_likelihood: Filtering to D!=0 retains original1/L weights. Conditional likelihood question mass is its disagreement frequency. Each raw question initially has total unit repeat weight.
direction: score=2u-1, zero equals raw u=.5; rank and target-coverage quantiles agree with u-only scoring.
r_zero: r-only zero-score is not a gain-sign boundary; smoothed probabilities make it an all-one gate, kept intact.
family_size: 20 nondefault indexed rules per frozen outer-fold procedure, including duplicate G patterns. No empirical duplicate is used to reduce certificate J.
primary_threshold: Always one of5 finite G candidates, without an added infinity default threshold. Exact default remains separate baseline/certification option.
nonnested_sensitivity: Each of4 score families at its pre-fixed G50% target threshold. Report actual dominance; never assume nonnesting.
G_to_E_score_shift: G scores nested-OOF heads, E scores full-G heads; stacking distribution difference is recorded.
B_feedback: Each seed-specific clone receives same20 G pairs frozen by F-P2; E never enters update.
real_certification: Five conditional fold procedures have different fitted rules. Construct F.1 task-stratified bounds per fold with delta .01 and per-task .005, no pooled iid600 certificate.
scientific_scope: controlled existing-development-data diagnosis; no independent fresh confirmation
